text:
maya: Hey all — first-week question: who owns VPC peering / private deploy access? Also who should I tag for model rollouts and canary configs? trying to build a quick "who-to-ping" map.

sam: Eng-Platform handles VPC & private deploys. ping @eng-platform for infra-level access. For model rollouts, it's split — eng-runtime owns the rollout infra, product owns policy + approval.

jordan: product here — yep, runtime handles the rollout mechanism. For policy/approval questions tag @product. For canaries use the runtime canary workflow.

lina: onboarding note: there's an "access & ownership" doc in the new-hires folder — I'll drop link in a sec: https://company.internal/onboarding/access-owners (you'll need SSO)

alex: runtime FYI — runtime oncall is @runtime-oncall. For urgent rollout breakages page #eng-oncall as well. For non-urgent questions open an ops ticket with template "rollout-help".

oncall-bot: @runtime-oncall is scheduled 2026-03-25 08:00-20:00 PST — primary: Alex.R (react :bell:)

sam: Short cheat sheet for you: VPC/access -> eng-infra; Private deploys -> eng-platform; Model rollouts & canaries -> eng-runtime + product; Incidents/SLA -> eng-sre; Dedicated capacity contracts -> sales-ops; Onboarding/access -> people-ops.

maya: super helpful — thanks. Do we have a documented escalation path (P1/P2) for rollout regressions? want to know who to notify for severity levels.

jordan: yes — P1: page eng-sre + eng-runtime + product leads and notify your manager; P2: page runtime + open incident ticket; P3: ticket only. I'll DM you the runbook link (contains steps + postmortem checklist).

lina: I'll also add you to the org chart and the "who-to-ping" google sheet we keep for on-call rotations.

alex: If you're blocked by deploy creds or infra config, reply here and I'll escalate to infra leads (fyi: infra leads are Sam K and Priya).

sam: Copyable mapping for your local notes:
```
Who-to-ping:
- VPC / Private deploys: @eng-platform / eng-infra
- Model rollouts & canaries: @eng-runtime + @product
- Severity P1 incidents: @eng-sre + @eng-runtime + product-leads
- Dedicated capacity / contracts: @sales-ops
- Onboarding access: @people-ops
- Immediate on-call: #eng-oncall (use page for P1)
```

maya: perfect — saving this. appreciate the fast responses :thumbsup:

sam: welcome aboard! ping any of us if something in the runbook is stale.
